description:
# 🚀 Hacknauts 2.0

### 🌌 Beyond the Known, Begins the Extraordinary

**Hacknauts 2.0 (HKN-26)** is a 24-hour, space-themed hackathon at **Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College, Ludhiana**, organized by the **Causmic Club**. 🚀

After a successful first mission, we're back in orbit. 🛰️ This year, everything revolves around one idea: **a black hole pulling streams of code into itself. 🕳️**

The brightest builders, designers, and problem-solvers converge for one weekend - to ideate, build, and ship something that didn't exist before. 💻✨

**One mission. One singularity. Your code, pulled toward something bigger. 🌠**

---

### 🌌 What Awaits You

* ⏱️ **24 hours** of building, mentorship, and midnight debugging
* 🛰️ **Multiple mission tracks** — revealed soon
* 🍕 **Free food, beverages, and high-speed internet** for all participants
* 🎁 **Swag and goodies** in every participant kit
* 🏅 **Certificates for every team + prizes** across tracks
* 🏆 **Best Freshers Team** — a special award for the best-performing team consisting of first-year students
* 👩‍🚀 **Best Girls Team** — a special award for the best-performing all-girls team
* 🤝 **A crew of like-minded builders** — and recruiters watching the launch pad

---

### 📍 Event Info

* 📅 **Date:** November 14–15, 2026
* 🏫 **Venue:** Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College, Gill Park, Ludhiana — 141006
* 👥 **Team Size:** 2–4 members
* 🧑‍💻 **Mode:** In-person
* 🪐 **Mission Code:** HKN-26 — every transmission carries it

---

### 📝 Registrations

* 🚀 **Process:** Apply right here on Devfolio

* 💬 **Join the WhatsApp & Discord for updates**

**[WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/EDvb3mBBEZQKKEBKEZCijD)**

**[Discord](https://discord.gg/fBpkNWM7d)**

---

### 📊 PPT Submission

All participating teams are required to submit their **project presentation (PPT)** before the deadline.

🎨 **[PPT Template](https://canva.link/btilhjpotmmporm)**

📤 **[Submit Your PPT](https://tally.so/r/pb2Xo1)**

⏰ **Submission Deadline:** **30 October 2026**

Make sure your presentation follows the provided template and is submitted before the deadline. 🚀

---

### 🌠 Your Mission Awaits

Build boldly. Think beyond the obvious. Solve something that matters.

**The singularity is waiting. What will you pull into orbit? 🕳️🚀**

**Hacknauts 2.0 - Beyond the Known, Begins the Extraordinary.**

hackathon_faqs.answer: Hacknauts is a 24-hour hackathon that aims to bring together developers, designers, and entrepreneurs to create innovative solutions to real-world problems.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is Hacknauts2.0 ?

hackathon_faqs.answer: The hackathon is open to students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate degrees in computer science, engineering, or related fields.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate in Hacknauts2.0?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes! There will be major meals and snacks provided to keep your energy up throughout the event. Your well-being is just as important to us as your creativity!
hackathon_faqs.question: Will there be food arrangements?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes! Participants are required to submit a PowerPoint presentation (PPT) outlining their idea and solution.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is there a preliminary round before the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Offline participation will be based on the evaluation of submitted ideas in the PPT. Only the best submissions will be invited to attend the hackathon in person.
hackathon_faqs.question: How will offline participants be selected?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Don't worry! We'll keep the energy up with engaging activities throughout the event. If you need a break, there will be designated resting zones, or you can take a quick nap at your desk 💤.
hackathon_faqs.question: What if I feel sleepy during the Hackathon?
